text: RESULTS: Vital Signs: Temperature 36.8°C (98°F), Blood Pressure 125/80 mmHg, Heart Rate 85 bpm, Respiratory Rate 20 breaths/min. speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of a large ovarian mass, ascites, and pleural effusion with a normal CA-125 level is highly suggestive of Meigs' syndrome rather than ovarian cancer. I will now proceed to confirm this diagnosis based on the clinical picture. DIAGNOSIS READY: Meigs' Syndrome
